Card Q&A.a: No, you can’t ignore digivolution requirements when using this effect. You can only digivolve this card into an applicable Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to digivolve it into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in my hand regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP until the end of their turn.
